gloss: omission (in a document); failure to include

definitions.gloss: omission; failure to include in a document; something left out of a written record
definitions.explanation: An item or piece of information that should have been written down or recorded but was accidentally left out. Commonly used in business and administrative contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{記載漏|きさいも}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was an omission in the document.

examples.japanese: {記載漏|きさいも}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check once more to make sure nothing was left out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申込書|もうしこみしょ}→申込書：03162_moushikomisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{記載漏|きさいも}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If there are omissions on the application form, the processing may be delayed.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧ (written entry/listing) + ⟦{漏|も}れ→漏れ：13362_more⟧ (omission, from ⟦{漏|も}れる→漏れる：02435_moreru⟧ 'to leak/be missing'). Used in business and administrative contexts for items accidentally left out of documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記載漏|きさいも}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is an omission
- {記載漏|きさいも}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check for omissions
- {記載漏|きさいも}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be careful about omissions

RELATED ～{漏|も}れ COMPOUNDS:
The suffix ～⟦{漏|も}れ→漏れ：13362_more⟧ is productive:
- {確認漏|かくにんも}れ: failure to check
- {連絡漏|れんらくも}れ: failure to notify
- {申告漏|しんこくも}れ: failure to declare/report

REGISTER:
Formal/business. Commonly seen on forms and in office communications.
